mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2D6 and CYP3A4), reducing primaquine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor for primaquine toxicity signs (hemolysis, methemoglobinemia, nausea); consider alternative H2-blocker (famotidine) or adjust primaquine dosing if cimetidine use is necessary.
